fusions.name: Gathering Sweep
fusions.desc: Drags a wide sweep 3 tiles ahead of you that deals 12 damage to everything in it. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Tine Prod
fusions.desc: A reaching jab with the tines on a target up to 4 tiles away that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Swept Clean
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after.

fusions.name: Gleaning
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 10 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.
